title: Chapter 348: The Situation In Yingying Town
content:
Chapter 348: The Situation In Yingying Town

Wang Shuo took some time to look at the other two battles. The saber-toothed tiger was obviously the strongest among the three monsters. Even if it was seriously injured, it could still fight.

The one fighting with Song Bo and the other two was a leopard, whose strength should be stronger than that of the red-haired baboon.

But the three of them joined forces and gained the upper hand. It was only a matter of time before they killed the leopard.

Wang Shuo no longer hid his weakness and went all out.

When Wang Shuo was still a junior general, it was almost impossible for him to fight a bronze boss alone.

But as a senior general, his level was improved, especially his qualifications were improved, a large number of attributes were added, and he learned martial arts and had internal strength.

All this became possible.

After a few more rounds.

The two dog heads on the left and right of Da Huang bit the two hands of the red-haired baboon, and the dog head in the middle spit out a mouthful of "corrosive poison" towards its head, directly corroding a piece of the red-haired baboon's head.

It struggled to break free from the dog head and immediately scratched its face with both hands.

Seeing this, Wang Shuo immediately aimed the Bloodthirsty Gun at the throat of the red-haired baboon.

The gun head went straight into the throat, and Wang Shuo followed with another horizontal cut.

He wanted to cut the throat.

But he failed, so Wang Shuo took advantage of the situation and pulled out the long gun.

This blow had cut off the trachea of the red-haired baboon, giving it a fatal blow.

Finally, after struggling for a few times, its huge body fell down with a bang.

Wang Shuo's battle was over, and the other two battles were also coming to an end.

Wang Cuilian punched the saber-toothed tiger's head and blew up the brain.

Then, she took out a demon pill from the broken head.

Wang Shuo understood.

The bald Song Bo did the same, swung the long knife, cut open the demon beast's head, and took out a demon pill.

Wang Shuo also stepped forward, and Da Huang bit the red-haired baboon's head and spit out a demon pill from his mouth.

Wang Shuo reached out to catch it.

The imagined slime was not there. The demon pill was crystal clear, smooth and neat on the surface, and was in the shape of a hexahedron and long strips.

At this point, the battle was over.

After seeing the battle process just now, several people had no intention of fighting each other.

In particular, now there are three forces, forming a strange balance.

Several people informed each other of their names.

Then they chatted casually, as if they were already close friends.

No other reason, several people wanted to find out some information they didn't know from each other.

Wang Shuo also had the same idea.

"Brother Song, what do you mean by the ranking list just now?"

As soon as Wang Shuo opened his mouth, he exposed the fact that he had just arrived here.

"It seems that Brother Wang has just arrived here not long ago! As long as you have been to Yingying Town, you will know that there is a stone tablet in Yingying Town, which shows the ranking of the people who have collected the most Shura Orders."

"Uh, that's it."

Wang Shuo didn't care about being known by others that he had just arrived here, as long as he was careful.

When people talk, three things are true and seven are false. If you say this, the other party may think that you are pretending to be a newcomer, and thus dare not act rashly.

Later, Wang Shuo learned that the fastest way to obtain the Shura Order is not to kill the opponent in the wild.

This method is the slowest and the most risky.

In Yingying Town, there is an arena where the generals can challenge and gamble with their opponents. Once they win, they can get a lot of Shura Orders.

There are even some people who are the banker and offer odds for gambling.

Coming to the wild is more to obtain demon pills and collect some precious medicinal materials.

Demon pills and medicinal materials can be used to refine pills. After taking them, they can recover from injuries, increase internal strength, or break through the limits of skills and ranks.

Wang Shuo learned about this and had a deeper understanding of cultivation.
